$Comment: The standalone RpgStations Cooking Fire work station block (scope-2 wave-3 leg W3-F, design section 2.7 fish exemplar, the remote-anchor half of the cutting-board/cooking-fire pair - it is BOTH a standalone direct cook loop AND the multi-station anchor CuttingBoard/PrepFish claims by proximity+type). Model/texture/hitbox lifted from the vanilla Deco_Campfire_Off (ledger [6cdea5ead]) - zero native Bench/Use fields; the vanilla Bench_Campfire is deliberately AVOIDED, it carries a native Bench:{Type:Processing} + Interactions.Use:'Open_Processing_Bench' that would fight this mod's own rpg_station_use interaction (the same RPG_Station_Sawmill-vs-Bench_Lumbermill discipline). State.Definitions.Lit swaps to the lit Blocks/Benches/Campfire.blockymodel plus embers Light + smoke Particles while a fish is cooking (Server/RpgStations/Stations/CookingFire.json's Custody.States.Loaded = 'Lit'); Default stays the unlit Campfire_Off model/texture. VariantRotation is authored NESW (a station-block placement convention, deliberately over the vanilla decorative RandomRotation) so the block's own facing composes correctly with Custody.Display's facing-relative Offset. When claimed as a remote anchor by another station's program, this block's OWN action is never invoked (design 2.2) - only its Custody claim and block state matter there.
